title: Doctor
description: Doctors find out why people are unwell and help them get better and stay healthy.
tryAtHome: Play doctor with a teddy and a pretend stethoscope
Learn the names of body parts
Count your pulse before and after jumping

title: Nurse
description: Nurses care for patients, give treatments, and help people and families understand their health.
tryAtHome: Practise caring for a toy patient
Learn how to wash hands properly
Learn first-aid basics with an adult

title: Veterinarian
description: Vets keep pets, farm animals and wildlife healthy and treat them when they are sick or hurt.
tryAtHome: Watch a pet or bird and note what is normal for it
Learn animal body parts
Read about how to care for a pet

title: Equine vet
description: Equine vets specialise in horses, ponies and donkeys, from check-ups to emergencies.
tryAtHome: Learn the parts of a horse
Calculate how much food and water a horse needs each day
Read about horse welfare

title: Paramedic
description: Paramedics respond to emergencies, give urgent care and take patients safely to hospital.
tryAtHome: Learn your local emergency number
Practise saying your address clearly
Learn first-aid basics

title: Mechanical engineer
description: Mechanical engineers design and improve machines, from bicycles and engines to robots.
tryAtHome: Look closely at how bicycle gears work
Build a cardboard machine with moving parts
Take apart (with an adult) an old broken toy

title: Civil engineer
description: Civil engineers plan and build bridges, roads, water systems and buildings that are safe and last.
tryAtHome: Build a paper bridge and test it with coins
Find how water reaches your home
Build towers from straws or sticks

title: Electrical engineer
description: Electrical engineers design systems that make, move and use electricity, from power grids to phones.
tryAtHome: With an adult, build a simple battery and bulb circuit
Read your home electricity meter
Find out how your local electricity is made

title: Marine biologist
description: Marine biologists study life in the oceans, from tiny plankton to whales.
tryAtHome: Learn the ocean zones
Visit a beach or pond with an adult and record what you see
Draw a food chain from the sea

title: Palaeontologist
description: Palaeontologists study fossils to learn about dinosaurs and ancient life.
tryAtHome: Make a fossil imprint in clay or dough
Sort pictures of dinosaurs by what they ate
Make a timeline of life on Earth

title: Environmental scientist
description: Environmental scientists study air, water, soil and wildlife to protect nature and people.
tryAtHome: Measure rainfall with a jar
Count birds or insects in one spot each week
Test which soil holds water best

title: Astronomer
description: Astronomers study stars, planets and galaxies to understand the universe.
tryAtHome: Draw the Moon each night for a month
Find a constellation with an adult
Make a scale model of the solar system

title: Software developer
description: Software developers write and test the programs that run apps, websites, games and machines.
tryAtHome: Play "be a robot" with step-by-step instructions
Write an algorithm for making a sandwich
Try a free block-coding site in a browser

title: Data scientist
description: Data scientists collect and analyse data to find patterns and help people make better decisions.
tryAtHome: Run a family survey and draw a bar chart
Track the weather for a month and look for patterns
Count and graph birds you see

title: Cybersecurity analyst
description: Cybersecurity analysts protect computers, networks and people's data from attacks.
tryAtHome: Create a secret code and break a friend's code
Learn the three-random-words password trick
Practise spotting scam messages

title: Accountant
description: Accountants keep track of money for people and organisations and help them plan and follow the rules.
tryAtHome: Keep a record of pocket money in and out
Help plan a shopping budget
Add up a receipt

title: Financial planner
description: Financial planners help people save, budget and plan for the future.
tryAtHome: Make a savings plan for something you want
Learn how interest works
Compare prices of the same item in different sizes

title: Actuary
description: Actuaries use maths and statistics to measure risk, for example for insurance and pensions.
tryAtHome: Roll dice 100 times and record the results
Work out the chance of rain from a month of weather records
Play strategy games and think about odds

title: Shop manager
description: Shop managers run stores: they order stock, look after staff and help customers.
tryAtHome: Play shop with price labels
Count stock in the kitchen cupboard
Plan the layout of a pretend shop

title: Marketing specialist
description: Marketing specialists help people find out about products and services, and learn what customers need.
tryAtHome: Design a poster for a family event
Survey family about their favourite snack
Compare how two adverts try to persuade you

title: Logistics manager
description: Logistics managers plan how goods travel from factories to shops and homes, quickly and safely.
tryAtHome: Plan the shortest route for errands on a map
Pack a bag so everything fits
Find out how a parcel travels

title: Farmer
description: Farmers grow crops and raise animals to produce food, fibre and fuel.
tryAtHome: Grow beans or herbs in a container
Make compost from vegetable scraps
Visit a farm or market with an adult

title: Horticulturist
description: Horticulturists grow and care for fruit, vegetables, flowers and trees, in gardens, nurseries and parks.
tryAtHome: Grow cress on damp paper
Take cuttings from a plant with an adult
Record how fast seeds sprout in light and dark

title: Stable manager
description: Stable managers look after horses' feeding, health, exercise and housing, and run the yard.
tryAtHome: Work out a feeding schedule for a pretend horse
Learn how to stay safe around horses
Budget the yearly cost of keeping a horse

title: Plumber
description: Plumbers install and repair pipes, taps, toilets and heating so homes have clean water and safe drains.
tryAtHome: Find the water shut-off valve at home with an adult
Watch how a tap works
Make a water pipe model with straws

title: Electrician
description: Electricians install and repair wiring, lights and sockets so electricity is safe to use.
tryAtHome: Learn electrical safety rules at home
With an adult, build a battery and bulb circuit
Find where the fuse box is (do not touch it)

title: Bicycle mechanic
description: Bicycle mechanics fix and maintain bikes: brakes, gears, chains and punctures.
tryAtHome: Check bike tyre pressure
Clean and oil a bike chain with an adult
Learn how to fix a puncture

title: Farrier
description: Farriers trim and care for horses' hooves and fit horseshoes. It needs long training.
tryAtHome: Learn the parts of a horse's hoof
Read about why horses need hoof care
Draw and measure a horseshoe shape

title: Carpenter
description: Carpenters build and repair things made of wood, from furniture to house frames.
tryAtHome: Measure and draw a plan for a box
Build with cardboard first
With an adult, sand and paint a piece of wood

title: Motor vehicle mechanic
description: Motor mechanics check, service and repair cars, vans and motorbikes, including electric vehicles.
tryAtHome: Watch an adult check tyre pressure and oil
Learn the main parts of a car
Draw how an electric motor turns

title: Chef
description: Chefs plan menus and cook food in restaurants, schools, hospitals and hotels.
tryAtHome: Help make a simple salad
Learn to wash hands and keep the kitchen clean
Plan a menu for a family meal

title: Baker
description: Bakers make bread, cakes and pastries, often starting very early in the morning.
tryAtHome: Measure ingredients for a simple recipe
Watch dough rise and talk about yeast
Weigh flour on a kitchen scale

title: Hotel manager
description: Hotel managers make sure guests are welcomed and looked after and that the hotel runs smoothly.
tryAtHome: Plan a "welcome" for a visiting relative
Make a cleaning and room plan
Learn greetings in another language

title: Musician
description: Musicians compose, perform and record music, alone or in groups.
tryAtHome: Make shakers and drums from containers
Clap rhythms and copy them
Learn a song from another country

title: Illustrator
description: Illustrators draw pictures for books, games, adverts and science.
tryAtHome: Draw a picture for a story you like
Make a comic strip
Draw a plant or animal carefully from life

title: Actor
description: Actors bring characters to life on stage, screen and radio.
tryAtHome: Act out a favourite story
Read a poem with feeling
Make a puppet show

title: Graphic designer
description: Graphic designers use pictures, colours and words to make posters, logos, signs and apps clear and attractive.
tryAtHome: Design a logo for your family
Make a poster with a clear message
Collect signs and decide which are easiest to read

title: Fashion designer
description: Fashion designers create clothes and accessories, choosing shapes, fabrics and colours.
tryAtHome: Draw outfit designs
With an adult, sew a button or simple seam
Redesign an old T-shirt

title: Architect
description: Architects design buildings and spaces that are safe, useful and beautiful.
tryAtHome: Draw a plan of your room from above
Build a model house from boxes
Look at buildings and sort their shapes

title: Lawyer
description: Lawyers give legal advice, write agreements and speak for people in courts.
tryAtHome: Hold a fair debate at home
Write family rules together
Read about children's rights

title: Judge
description: Judges listen to both sides in court, apply the law and make fair decisions.
tryAtHome: Listen to two sides of a family disagreement and suggest a fair solution
Learn how laws are made
Practise weighing evidence

title: Paralegal
description: Paralegals support lawyers by researching, organising documents and preparing cases.
tryAtHome: Organise family documents into folders (with permission)
Research a question using a library
Summarise a news story fairly

title: Teacher
description: Teachers help people of all ages learn new knowledge and skills.
tryAtHome: Teach a younger child or a teddy something you know
Make a quiz for your family
Explain how to do something in 3 steps

title: Early years educator
description: Early years educators care for and teach babies and young children through play.
tryAtHome: Read a picture book to a younger child
Make up a counting song
Plan a play activity for a toddler with an adult

title: Librarian
description: Librarians help people find books and information, and run reading and learning activities.
tryAtHome: Sort your books into groups
Make a reading list for a friend
Visit a library

title: Firefighter
description: Firefighters put out fires, rescue people and teach fire safety.
tryAtHome: Learn your family fire escape plan
Check that smoke alarms work, with an adult
Learn your local emergency number

title: Police officer
description: Police officers help keep communities safe, respond to emergencies and investigate crimes.
tryAtHome: Learn your address and emergency number
Play a detective game looking for clues
Learn road safety rules

title: Social worker
description: Social workers support children, families and adults through hard times and help keep them safe.
tryAtHome: Practise active listening with a family member
Learn about children's rights
Help someone who needs a hand

title: Town planner
description: Town planners decide where homes, parks, roads and shops should go so places work well for people.
tryAtHome: Draw a map of your street
Design a new park for your area
Count traffic at one spot for 10 minutes with an adult

title: Research scientist
description: Research scientists ask questions and run careful experiments to discover new knowledge.
tryAtHome: Ask a question and test it with a fair experiment
Keep a science notebook
Repeat an experiment to check results

title: Archaeologist
description: Archaeologists study objects and places from the past to learn how people lived.
tryAtHome: Bury and dig up objects in a sandpit or tray
Interview a grandparent about the past
Map your local old buildings

title: Sports scientist
description: Sports scientists study how the body moves and how people can train and recover safely.
tryAtHome: Measure your pulse before and after exercise
Time a sprint and graph your progress
Learn about warm-ups

title: Entrepreneur
description: Entrepreneurs spot problems and start businesses or projects to solve them.
tryAtHome: Run a pretend shop
Think of a problem at home and invent a solution
Plan a tiny business and work out costs

title: Social entrepreneur
description: Social entrepreneurs start projects or businesses that help communities or the environment.
tryAtHome: Organise a book or toy swap
Plan a small community project
Find out about a local charity

title: App or game studio founder
description: Founders of app and game studios turn an idea into a product and build a team to make it.
tryAtHome: Design a paper prototype of an app or game
Ask friends to test your game and give feedback
Make a simple budget for your idea
